messages.content: I keep feeling guilty for wanting more out of my career than my parents ever expected.
Honestly, that guilt is really common in first-generation-ambition situations. Where do you think it's actually coming from?
Maybe feeling like I'm rejecting how they raised me by wanting different things.
That's honestly a really thoughtful way to name it - but wanting more doesn't have to mean rejecting where you came from, those can coexist.
I hadn't thought of it that way before, honestly.
Glad that reframe helps, genuinely - ambition and gratitude for your roots aren't actually in conflict.
